text:
julia: FYI — Customer FinBank reports bulk key import to on-prem HSM partially failed. Some keys show up in KMS but are NOT present in HSM audit and subsequent signing calls return 403/CKR_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE_INVALID. Ticket #56543. Repro steps & logs below. Escalating to eng-infra + security.

julia: Repro steps we used (customer provided):
1) redwood-kms import --file finbank-keys.tar.gz --cluster onprem-eu-01 --preserve-tags=false --tags 'env=prod,customer=finbank'
2) import exits 0 but signing job fails when referencing new key ids

julia: Relevant API error seen in app logs:```json
{"error":"forbidden","code":403,"message":"key access denied: tag mismatch"}
```

devon: Is this CloudHSM or on-prem Luna? Any recent firmware/agent changes on onprem-eu-01?

julia: On-prem Luna HSM cluster (Luna v7.3), cluster id onprem-eu-01, firmware 7.3.1-rc2, redwood-kms-agent v2.12.4. Customer says they re-ran import twice, same symptom.

sunil: Requesting the HSM audit snippet and the import tool stdout. Also need the redwood-kms-agent logs around the import time and the KMS policy attached to the imported keys. Possible attribute/label mapping mismatch.

julia: Paste of the agent tail (sanitized):```
[2026-02-13T09:08:12Z] import: starting archive=finbank-keys.tar.gz count=120
[2026-02-13T09:08:12Z] import: key=kb_abc123 status=ok handle=0x7f
[2026-02-13T09:08:12Z] import: key=kb_def456 status=ok handle=0x80
[2026-02-13T09:08:12Z] import: key=kb_ghi789 status=ok handle=0x81
[2026-02-13T09:08:12Z] verify: key=kb_def456 audit-event=missing
[2026-02-13T09:08:12Z] error: CKR_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE_INVALID while setting CKA_LABEL for key=kb_def456
[2026-02-13T09:08:12Z] import: completed 120 attempted=120 succeeded=117 failed=3
```

clare: If agent reports CKR_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE_INVALID while setting CKA_LABEL that's consistent with tag/label attributes being rejected by this firmware. We recently landed a change that strips unknown attributes by default; if the import tool sent an attribute batch that included our internal tags it could reject. Is the customer using custom tag keys with characters (like '.')? Old firmware rejects some characters.

julia: Customer used tags like "env=prod,customer=finbank,product.version=3.1" — note the dot in product.version. They also use a KMS wrapper policy that expects CKA_LABEL to contain "finbank-" prefix.

sunil: Two immediate asks: 1) provide audit subsystem export for the import window (we need to see which key IDs have create events), 2) export the HSM PKCS#11 session log around CKR_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE_INVALID. Those will show whether keys were created without labels.

julia: Pasted a small slice of HSM audit (sanitized):```
[2026-02-13T09:08:12] AUDIT CREATE keyid=kb_abc123 user=svc-importer result=OK
[2026-02-13T09:08:12] AUDIT CREATE keyid=kb_def456 user=svc-importer result=OK
[2026-02-13T09:08:12] AUDIT SET_ATTRIBUTE keyid=kb_def456 attribute=CKA_LABEL result=FAILED
[2026-02-13T09:08:12] AUDIT CREATE keyid=kb_ghi789 user=svc-importer result=OK
[2026-02-13T09:08:12] AUDIT CREATE keyid=kb_jkl000 user=svc-importer result=OK
```

devon: So keys exist at HSM level but label set failed for a subset. That would make KMS not list them since KMS uses label->key mapping to surface keys. That explains observed mismatch and 403s for tag-based access control.

clare: For repro locally: can we try importing a minimal set with dot in tag to confirm? Example:```bash
redwood-kms import --file single-key.pem --cluster onprem-eu-01 --tags 'product.version=3.1' --verbose
```

julia: Ran that with customer. Verbose output:```
importing single-key.pem -> keyid=kb_test001
setting attributes: CKA_LABEL=finbank-kb_test001
error: CKR_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE_INVALID when writing CKA_LABEL
exit 1
```

sunil: Proposed mitigations:
- Short term: re-run imports with tags sanitized (remove dots and other disallowed chars) or use --preserve-labels=false and then set tags in KMS metadata layer rather than HSM attributes.
- Medium term: add validation in redwood-kms import to fail early on unsupported attributes and surface a clear error with allowed charset.
- If customer needs immediate keys live: create temporary KMS-managed wrapping keys (software-backed) and swap signing pipeline to use them until full import + label fix window.

julia: Customer impact: production signing pipelines for settlement queue are failing (approx 10% of signing calls). They called this a Sev-1 because settlement slippage causes accounting mismatches. Asking for an ETA to fix and whether we need a maintenance window to re-run label fix tool.

devon: I'm taking oncall ownership. I'll coordinate with infra to request a maintenance window for onprem-eu-01. Need: 1) approved window 2) sudo access to redwood agent on the bastion, 3) HSM vendor support on standby if firmware quirk shows up.

clare: I'll file a small hotfix to the import CLI to sanitize tags and add explicit pre-check. If we can push a patch to 2.12.5 we can run it immediately in the onprem cluster.

sunil: Security ok with the plan as long as we record all manual label writes in the audit and notify customer. Also want an action to review allowed charset and update docs and API validation.

julia: Action list so far:
- devon: schedule maintenance window + own rollback plan (assigned)
- clare: prepare import CLI hotfix and test on canary (assigned)
- sunil: collect full HSM audit + PKCS#11 logs and vendor SR (assigned)
- julia: coordinate customer comms, timeline and temporary workaround (assigned)

devon: I'll update ticket #56543 with ETA after I get an approved window (target within 6 hours). Adding @oncall-bot :rotating_light:.

oncall-bot: Incident note created -> INC-2026-022 (linked to ticket #56543).

julia: Thanks — keep thread updated with any kernel/firmware errors. Customer asks for next update T+2 hours.

clare: Quick note: if we cannot change labels on already-created keys, we can create alias entries in KMS metadata to map labelless HSM handles to the expected label; I'll prototype a small mapping script during the maintenance window.

sunil: Also file a post-incident eval: why import didn't validate attributes earlier and why agent returned success for create but not attribute set. Might be an edge race between create and attribute write.

julia: Acknowledged. Closing the slack escalation thread for now — will reopen if something blocks the maintenance window. :white_check_mark:
